sentences.text: 2 12-02-2016 Learned counsel for the review petitioners submits that the order under review dated 30.11.2015 proceeds on the basis of an error of fact, in that a learned Single Judge in paragraphs 59, 69 and 70 of the judgment under review has treated the Laboratory report dated 16.04.2014 as negative report.

A perusal of the said Laboratory report appearing at page 109 of the review petition records the following opinion:
"The Sample of Split Betel Nut does not conform to the standards laid down under regulation No. 2.12 &
2.3.47(5) of Food Safety and Standards (FSS) Act, 2006 and FSS (Food Products & Food Additive)
Regulations, 2011 as the damaged & discolored Nuts including Insect Damaged Betel Nuts exceeds the prescribed limits."
2. Issue notice to the opposite parties for which requisites etc. under registered cover with A/D as well as ordinary process must be filed within one week, failing which this application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.
3. List this case after eight weeks or on receipt of service report whichever is earlier, under the same heading.
